Samir K: Details? target RPS and dates?

{
  "egress_ips": ["203.0.113.32/28", "203.0.113.64/28"],

  "canary_policy": "10% -> 50% in 48h if healthy"

Eng Platform: We can stand up a dedicated mini-pool and pin traffic. Need SRE/Oncall signoff for capacity and fallback SLOs.

Maya R: Scheduling a 30-min runbook call 2026-04-11 09:00 UTC with customer + Eng Platform.
Samir K: I'll verify CIDRs and attach the signed network letter to ticket INC-81321 and ping Legal for a temporary peering addendum. Renewal due in 6 weeks — CS wants perf snapshot after 72h.
emberwood-support-bot: Action items added to INC-81321: add egress CIDRs, provision eu-west mini-pool, create canary rollout with fallback, issue scoped test tokens, pre-warm cache.
Eng Platform: Drafting canary rollout policy and pool provisioning, will post by EOD. Note: ensure token masking in logs.
Ops Oncall: After draft posted, will run dry-run validation. If green, approve 120rps short bump.
Maya R: Thanks all — I'll send invites and attach the runbook. Drop Legal/Network updates here. :thumbsup:
